title: Tax Audit Report Schedule for Section 43B Liabilities (Clause 26) & Employee Welfare Contributions (Clause 20(b))
statutoryDueWindow: On or before September 30 (or October 31 as extended under Section 139(1)) of the relevant Assessment Year

subClauses.description: Any sum payable by way of tax, duty, cess or fee under any law (GST, Customs, Property Tax, etc.)
Any sum payable by the assessee as an employer by way of contribution to provident fund, superannuation fund, gratuity fund, or staff welfare fund
Any sum payable as bonus or commission to employees for services rendered (Section 36(1)(ii))
Any sum payable as interest on loan or borrowing from Public Financial Institutions, SFCs, SIICs
Any sum payable as interest on loan or borrowing from deposit-taking NBFC or systemically important non-deposit taking NBFC
Any sum payable as interest on loan or advance from scheduled bank or co-operative bank
Any sum payable by the assessee as an employer in lieu of leave at the credit of his employee (leave encashment)
Any sum payable by the assessee to Indian Railways for the use of railway assets

clause20bEmployeeWelfareReporting.description: Details of contributions received from employees for various funds as referred to in Section 36(1)(va)
